limits: Complete inventory and declared text search are not comprehensive semantic review of every file.
Nested binary archives, Office/PDF containers, dependencies, non-UTF-8 content and link targets were not semantically parsed.
Only selected Git paths and reachable archived refs were reviewed; most repository history and unreachable/deleted/renamed paths remain outside scope.
Two selected paths reached the 100-change-commit cap. Most historical blobs were decoded/indexed; detailed semantic history review focused on seven operational paths.
The notebook historical blob was read with an explicit 64MiB allowance; other selected historical blobs were bounded at 8MiB.
Short ticket matching used narrow context rules; no admitted candidates does not establish absence of ticket material.
Eight short/generic organization name or alias strings were excluded from literal matching. Their longer names or domains may still be searched; this is not exhaustive alias discovery.
Case-insensitive discovery is followed by exact field/context review. No company, invoice, event or person total is inferred from string-hit counts.
